protocol.data_role: new procedural development mechanisms, not natural-image or held-out evidence
protocol.matched_time: last trace sample at or before common minimum terminal elapsed time within family/seed
protocol.missing_policy: retain all errors; incomplete family has no positive verdict; no selective rerun
protocol.objective: raw 0.5 mean squared RGB error, whole image; no mask or display clamp in fitting
protocol.order: rotate arm order by seed; one separate warmed process per cell
protocol.primary: terminal 160-step PSNR against per-seed best-of-three Adam envelope
protocol.scoring: raw PSNR floor MSE1e-12; display-clamped MS-SSIM/LPIPS
protocol.terminal: exact 160 attempted updates; terminal state, no best-checkpoint selection
protocol.timing: complete fit including gradients, curvature, trial renders and scalar trace; descriptive only
protocol.timing_scope: shared workstation; record GPU process snapshots, no speed or isolated-time claim
protocol.warmup: seed77 translated, 2 steps each Adam, diagonal, block
